Beaconlight Capital Has Increased Its Holding in Anadarko Pete (APC) by $996,000; As Apple (AAPL) Market Value Rose, Shareholder Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America Has Trimmed Its Holding
June 12, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 29.35% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America sold 4,910 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 11,817 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.98 million, down from 16,727 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guardian Life Insurance Company Of America who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $945.08 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.55% or $1.05 during the last trading session, reaching $192.28. About 14.85 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
